scope: Close November 5 historical release work fulfilled by the November 6 continuation; preserve later and concurrent changes

findings.finding: Diagnostic workflow refuses synchronized Builds checkout
findings.evidence: The snapshot initializes the root Builds gitlink 27145e52ffab5623198ba5efdab5cdb71aa42d28 but requires 3c8096180ecf2aa539ac454815efbfceb8a92822. This is a later source-adoption mismatch after the completed 50904cc4 release; reconcile measured runtime authority and checkout selection without blindly blessing a new tuple.

findings.finding: Mandatory public verifier refuses synchronized source tuple
findings.evidence: The CI caller supplies root gitlinks e39a9a2587ec150d550510763ab69db305d13fdb and 27145e52ffab5623198ba5efdab5cdb71aa42d28, while validate requires 0f4e27f1f78310bd731c10c19dc51bb1e0345d44 and 3c8096180ecf2aa539ac454815efbfceb8a92822 before reading evidence. The public gate was introduced in 71f61d89cf9a1aa3a60e2065f913b95b4b2a639b after this release.

findings.finding: Ownership marker initialization can leak a preparation directory
findings.evidence: 18dd525c3ee80b065bb410bc639cef89f15f163a moved marker creation/write outside the cleanup try. An I/O failure can leave an occupied directory that DeleteOwnedDirectory cannot authenticate. The released 50904cc4 source retained its initialization catch; this is a later regression.

findings.finding: Diagnostic Dapr downloads lacked archive digest checks in the snapshot
findings.evidence: Current committed d3d5e7d4de132c3e8b81d1ab04fb8c3541b8aaa4 reads pinned digest metadata, validates its schema and SHA shape, and verifies each archive before tar. The independently committed correction closes the snapshot finding; no additional edit is needed.

findings.finding: Private verifier accepts its two required native cases
findings.evidence: The frozen intent explicitly requires both actual native cases. CASES names those exact two and the verifier checks unique presence, all passed outcomes and consistent counters. Whole-suite execution is enforced by the invoking test runner; the release receipt independently records all 28 actual cases. No requirement for the private evidence reader to freeze all evolving helper-test names was established.

findings.finding: Private verifier does not read selectorCompatibilityObserved
findings.evidence: PartyEnvironmentTests unconditionally awaits AssertLiveSelectorCompatibilityAsync before persistence observation publication, and emits the flag as literal true. The required passing native case therefore includes those assertions. Changing only the redundant flag in a synthetic resealed document does not demonstrate a supported producer that omits the selector checks or a new false acceptance.

findings.finding: Private verifier ignores assembly scope labels
findings.evidence: The loaded and copied arrays already identify distinct roles and each is checked against the exact SDK identity/body map. NativeAssemblyObservations generates fixed labels from actual process/reflection and copied-output measurements; swapping labels alone changes neither measurement nor admission. No supported producer or substituted body escaping the actual checks was shown.

findings.finding: Equivalent creation timestamp spellings compare unequal
findings.evidence: The real native observation serializes createdEnvelope.Timestamp and the equal detail.CreatedAt as DateTimeOffset values in the same anonymous document/serializer. Native assertions require the values to be equal before issuance. The proposed mixed Z/+00:00 spelling is a synthetic re-encoding, not a demonstrated output of the supported producer; the actual 28-case release report passed.

findings.finding: Public verifier permits a far-future measuredAtUtc
findings.evidence: The value is syntactically validated and ordered after container startup; the producer writes DateTimeOffset.UtcNow while source/run/body authority is independently checked. Replacing only this diagnostic time does not substitute any run, image or body. No normal clock/producer failure was demonstrated; adding a new execution-interval authority/tolerance surface is disproportionate for this diagnostic edge.

findings.finding: Observer could report empty for contradictory resourceIds/isEmpty
findings.evidence: CompositionRunResources.IsEmpty and ResourceIds are computed read-only properties of the pinned producer. Empty five-kind inventories with unverified=false compute isEmpty=true and resourceIds=[]; the proposed contradiction cannot be serialized by that producer. Both actual release cleanup receipts and the mandatory verifier independently establish complete emptiness.

findings.finding: Public evidence caller tuple differs from required published tuple
findings.evidence: Independently confirms R-B02 at the CI caller and verifier boundary. It concerns the public-profile adoption introduced after released source 50904cc4, and does not invalidate the original current-owner release proof.

findings.finding: Diagnostic input fence differs from synchronized Builds selection
findings.evidence: Independently confirms R-B01. Keep publication/runtime authority distinct from root source selection when fixing the later workflow; do not replace a qualified digest with an unqualified tip.

findings.finding: Canceled asset-staging test can leave its MSBuild process running
findings.evidence: NativeAdminUiAssetStagingTests StageAsync awaits WaitForExitAsync with the test token but has no kill/wait finally; Process.Dispose does not terminate the child. Outer directory deletion can race the still-running child. This test was added after the completed release, in the preserved November 9 preparation work.

findings.finding: Split private catalog source staging lacks executed GenerateAsync regression
findings.evidence: Preverified: existing cleanup cases invoke RunAsync via reflection, and normal CI selects configuration/cleanup classes without executing GenerateAsync. Program.cs references PublishedCatalogArtifactCohort in another source, so reverting to Program-only staging evades the selected tests but breaks runtime generation. This is a preserved concurrent development-catalog change outside the completed release snapshot.

findings.finding: Public evidence tuple mismatch is hidden by synthetic constants
findings.evidence: Independently confirms R-B02; synthetic fixtures replace expected identities with verifier constants and the workflow test inspects text. A real caller/reader tuple control is needed for the later adoption.
